Speaking & moderating

Open to speaking and moderating.

Eight years across communications, operations, and now software. A year of that was spent running technical operations and CRM architecture end to end, mostly alone. I don't show up to these conversations as a theorist. I show up as someone who's lived through the career switch, the AI adoption panic, and the unglamorous mechanics of what makes a technical team work. Available for talks, panels, and moderation.

Talk / Panel

Career Transition: Communications to Code

What it actually takes to move from a communications and operations background into software engineering. No polished-arrival story, the real mechanics of the switch.

Talk / Panel

Women in Tech: Building a Visible Track Record

Why credibility in tech is built through documented, public work, not just skill. Practical framing for women navigating the same path.

Talk / Panel

Systems Thinking for Engineers

How operator experience, the kind you get running real campaigns and CRMs, changes how you design and debug software.

Moderator

Panels on AI Adoption & Career Change

Comfortable holding a room, keeping panelists on time and on topic, and asking the question the audience actually wants answered.
